body_lead: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said the Uttar Pradesh Government is committed to establishing Lucknow among India’s leading AI innovation cities and will develop a strong innovation ecosystem over the next five years. Addressing a programme organised to mark the 10th anniversary of the HCL Tech Lucknow campus, the Chief Minister said the government will extend full support to establish at least 50 world-class AI startups in Lucknow, strengthen them and help them reach global markets. He also urged HCL Tech to partner with the state government in this initiative.
